title: Track Guide Okayama - Full BMW M2 CSR iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: brake at 100 board, 80% pressure, trail brake to curb
corners.exit: throttle gently, exit left, move right for T2
corners.mistakes: easy to lose rear, avoid full throttle

corners.label: T2
corners.braking: brake at Marshall post, 20% pressure, trail brake

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: brake at 100 board, 70% pressure, trail brake to curb
corners.exit: throttle key, stay close to curb

corners.label: T5
corners.braking: Break at pole, 90% pressure, ease off to curb

corners.label: T6
corners.braking: Start braking without clear marker, 30% pressure, ease off to curb
corners.exit: Apply throttle, ease in, aim white line center

corners.label: T7
corners.braking: Break on curb in front, 30% then trail brake
corners.line: Get up on inside curb, ease throttle
corners.exit: Stay right side of track for turn 8

corners.label: T8
corners.line: Mid track, aim to open up to turn 9

corners.label: T9
corners.braking: Tire wall on left, 50% brake, trail brake

corners.label: T11
corners.braking: brake at green AST Toia, 55% brake pressure
corners.line: cut curb, turn-in to left side of track
corners.exit: throttle, ease in to stabilize car

general_tips: Throttle application is key for exit speed
Natural car push to left side of track
use all of the Astro on the left side
direct race down to the start Finish Line
